title: 第26章 胜利
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
训练室中。

    柳毅脸上的表情瞬间凝固，双臂传来沉闷的痛楚，整个人被这股力量推的向后踉跄两步，才勉强站稳。

    他死死的盯着陈峰，脑子里嗡嗡作响。

    这种力量……怎么可能？！

    场边，梁越的瞳孔也是微微一缩，他一眼就看出来了，陈峰刚才那一拳爆发出的力量，不亚于柳毅！

    这小子的体质……居然也达到了14.5？

    而柳毅心中错愕，脸上青一阵白一阵，他无法接受！

    自己辛辛苦苦修炼这么久，花了无数资源，体质才堪堪达到14.5，这个陈峰凭什么？！

    “再来！”

    柳毅怒吼一声，双臂肌肉再度坟起，主动发起了攻击！

    “劈山手！”

    他一步踏出，右手成掌，带着呼啸的风声，自上而下，猛的朝陈峰的头顶劈来！

    这一招，他练了近一年，早已烂熟于心，一掌劈下，有开碑裂石之威！

    然而，面对这势大力沉的一击，陈峰不闪不避。

    就在掌风即将及体的瞬间，他身躯一侧，脚下错步，轻巧的滑开半寸，蛇盘。

    右手斩刀般切出，精准的贴上了柳毅的手腕，顺着他下劈的力道一引一带。

    柳毅只觉得掌力劈了个空，全身的力道都像是打进了棉花里，身体更是不由自主的朝前倾倒，破绽大开！

    紧接着眼前一花，陈峰身形便如同游蛇般靠近，贴身上前，右手如同盘蛇般缠绕上柳毅的手臂，

    而后猛然爆发，一股阴狠的绞杀之力瞬间倾泻而出，仿佛一头凶悍有力的巨蟒，近乎要勒断柳毅的手臂！

    蛇杀术·蛇绞！

    “咔！”

    清脆的骨节错位声在训练室里响起！

    “呃——！”

    柳毅发出一声痛苦的闷哼，整张脸瞬间没了血色，冷汗刷的一下就冒了出来。

    他的整条右臂被陈峰以一个极其诡异的角度锁死，一股钻心的剧痛从肩关节和肘部传来。

    他甚至能感觉到自己的骨头在哀嚎，再多用一分力，这条胳膊就要被硬生生绞断！

    “等……”

    梁越面色微变刚要张口劝阻，陈峰便已经松开了手。

    而柳毅像是被抽掉了全身的骨头，整个人瘫软在地，抱着自己的右臂，大口大口的喘着粗气，脸上满是痛苦。

    训练室里，一片死寂。

    段耀辉不可思议的瞪大了眼睛，五秒……不，顶多三秒！

    体质14.5，劈山手即将练至小成的柳毅，就这么输了？

    而冯曦嘴角那抹讥讽的笑容早已彻底僵硬，她站在原地，目光紧紧的盯着陈峰，一脸惊疑。

    梁越同样是一脸的难以置信，他快步走到柳毅身边检查了一下，还好，只是关节脱臼，没有伤到骨头。

    他松了口气，随即站起身，转头看向陈峰。
content_en:
In the training room.

The expression on Liu Yi's face froze for an instant, and dull pain came from his arms. He was pushed back by the force and staggered two steps before he could barely stand still.

He stared at Chen Feng, his mind buzzing.

How is this kind of power possible?!

On the sidelines, Liang Yue's pupils shrank slightly. He could tell at a glance that the power that Chen Feng just punched was no less than Liu Yi!

This guy's physique... actually reached 14.5?

But Liu Yi was shocked, his face turned blue and white, he couldn't accept it!

I have practiced hard for so long and spent countless resources to reach a physical level of 14.5. Why is this Chen Feng?!

"Come again!"

Liu Yi roared angrily, the muscles of his arms rose again, and he took the initiative to attack!

"Mountain splitter!"

He took one step forward, his right hand formed into a palm, and with the sound of howling wind, he struck from top to bottom towards the top of Chen Feng's head!

He has practiced this move for nearly a year, and has long been familiar with it. A strike with one palm has the power to crack a monument and crack a stone!

However, facing this powerful and heavy blow, Chen Feng did not dodge.

At the moment when the palm wind was about to reach his body, he took a wrong step on one side of his body and lightly slid half an inch away, coiling his body.

The right hand cut out like a slashing knife, and accurately attached to Liu Yi's wrist, following the force of his slashing force.

Liu Yi only felt that the force of his palm was smashed into the air, and all the strength in his body seemed to be driven into cotton. His body fell forward involuntarily, and the flaws were wide open!

Immediately after his eyes flashed, Chen Feng approached like a snake, leaned forward, and wrapped his right hand around Liu Yi's arm like a coiled snake.

Then it suddenly broke out, and a vicious strangulation force poured out instantly, like a fierce and powerful python, almost trying to strangle Liu Yi's arm!

Snake killing technique·Snake twisting!

"Click!"

The crisp sound of dislocated joints resounded in the training room!

"Uh-!"

Liu Yi let out a painful groan, his entire face lost all color in an instant, and he broke out in cold sweat.

His entire right arm was locked at an extremely weird angle by Chen Feng, and a heartbreaking pain came from his shoulder joint and elbow.

He could even feel his bones howling. If he exerted more force, his arm would be severed!

"Wait..."

Liang Yue's expression changed slightly and just when he was about to open his mouth to dissuade, Chen Feng let go of his hand.

Liu Yi seemed to have had all his bones ripped out, and he collapsed on the ground, holding his right arm, breathing heavily, his face full of pain.

There was dead silence in the training room.

Duan Yaohui's eyes widened in disbelief, five seconds... no, three seconds at most!

Liu Yi, who has a physique of 14.5 and is about to reach a small level of mountain splitting skill, lost like this?

The sarcastic smile on Feng Xi's lips had already completely stiffened. She stood there, staring closely at Chen Feng with a look of surprise on her face.

Liang Yue also had a look of disbelief on his face. He quickly walked to Liu Yi and checked. Fortunately, it was just a dislocated joint and no broken bones.

He breathed a sigh of relief, then stood up and turned to look at Chen Feng.
